source: ref/morpheus/records_stream.bin (biphase-mark transfer audio, 289 records, stride 332, record 0 at byte 340)

law.record: 12-byte ASCII name + 320-byte payload; payload = 7 stage blocks of 44 bytes + 12-byte gain/tail block
law.stage_block: 32 contiguous 11-bit fields, MSB-first within little-endian u32 stream: param-major, 8 corners per param; params = [pole_angle, pole_radius, zero_angle, zero_radius]
law.gain_block: payload bytes 308..319: 8 x 11-bit per-corner cascade gains
law.field: 11-bit stored = top 11 bits of 15-bit runtime code; unpacker refills low 4 bits with 0xF (firmware 0x080382FC)
law.corner_index: bit0 = Transform2, bit1 = Morph, bit2 = Frequency tracking (evidence: LPFlange.4 corner structure vs manual F001)
